summary: 合成软件流程演示；不提供科学或商业证据。
rationale: 检查计划、审查、执行和报告是否能串联。

protocol.hypothesis: Synthetic software fixture: verify control flow only; no scientific claim.
protocol.baseline: Constant synthetic score 10; not a real research baseline
controlled_variables: Frozen time splits and dataset hash
Same compute and tuning limits; one fixed candidate

outcomes.go: Proceed to an independently preregistered deployment-cost evaluation; this is not deployment approval.
outcomes.stop: Reject this candidate route. Do not increase architecture or tuning to rescue it.
outcomes.invalid: No hypothesis conclusion: document the failed check and preregister a corrected measurement.

assumptions: 所有输出都是预先设定的软件测试数据。
risks: 本地 worker 有当前用户权限，只能运行人工检查过的可信代码。
